title: Nil Darpan; or, The Indigo Planting Mirror
seoTitle: Nil Darpan - Indigo Revolt Literary Source
seoDescription: Dinabandhu Mitra's Indigo Revolt-era play, available through an archive scan of the English translation.
note: A contemporary literary-political text associated with the Indigo Revolt and public exposure of planter abuses.
whyItMatters: It preserves how the indigo crisis entered public culture and helps connect agrarian protest with print, theatre, and colonial controversy.
